materials.item: This online course text (web book)
Google Colab (sign in with Illinois account; share notebooks with professor and TA)
Gradescope (submit .pdf printout and .ipynb)

PHYS 246.attendance: Every class starts with a quiz on last week's assignment. A missed class means a missed quiz, with no retakes.
PHYS 246.lateWork: Assignments due at start of next class. Both the Colab share link and the PDF must be in on time or the work is not graded; it counts as late if the missing part arrives after the deadline. Extensions
PHYS 246.makeups: No quiz retakes. Lowest 2 quizzes dropped instead; a drop or replacement for illness only if it lasts 3+ weeks, with documentation.
other: LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude etc.) are discouraged; the instructor says they do more harm than good at this stage
Code found online must be credited with its URL in a comment; asking for a ready-made script for the whole task is not allowed
Collaboration is allowed but you must submit your own work; 5 points of each problem set are for mandatory questions (time spent, references, collaborators)
No solutions to homework are posted; partial credit is limited
